'''The Goddess''' was the primary deity of the [[Pius Dea]], a monotheistic faith that controlled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for over a millennia during the [[Pius Dea Era]]. According to Pius Dea belief, those who purified or destroyed "unpure" beings would be handsomely rewarded by the Goddess.
